Personally, I don't need to do this blocking method as I've disabled most things from even communicating at all. This is merely a last resort that I'll leave enabled on my router in case a friend visits or I'm testing a new install in a VM. This has the advantage over a local host file that Windows can't bypass it. Currently Windows has certain domains that it will ignore (google dnsapi.dll whitelist) in the host file.

Plus, now that you know how to do this, you can add other domains to your router to block if you want.

The US seriously needs some labor reform. My current job isn't too bad, but the pay could be better considering the size of sales I deal with and the amount of effort I have to put in, but it's still leagues ahead of flipping burgers and a decent company culture of respect for the employee.

Most of my past jobs on the flip side have been a nightmare in dealing with corporate. I pulled my two longest shifts at one job on a salaried check of one being a 24 hour stretch, just minutes over the 24 hour mark, and the second being a 36 hour bender of a shift. With all my experience in management I've very dead set against ever doing it again since once breaching the salaried range it seems to give corporate the impression that our personal time is to be used at their leisure.

Company perks have gone down over the last 17 of my working years, wages have stagnated, I'm literally only making a dollar more than what I was in 03. Benefits in general are a joke especially if you're paying for a family. At the very least I get a modest amount of paid time off, much more so than many I know, but my company is fearful of unions so they try to stay just enough ahead to keep the thought out of our minds. At one previous job even mention of a union and you would be terminated with in a week for 'unrelated reasons'.

This is going to end up like turn of the century US all over again with labor disputes coming out the wazoo and no one to go to for reform because there's apparently 7 other people who'd take the job just for any income.
